Here’s a solid **cover letter format** with a real-world example for each section. A cover letter should ideally be one page, tailored for the specific job, and show why you're a strong fit.

---

### **COVER LETTER FORMAT**

#### 1. **Header**
Include your contact info and the date, followed by the employer’s info.

```plaintext
[Your Name]  
[Your Address]  
[City, State, Zip]  
[Email Address] | [Phone Number] | [LinkedIn Profile]  

[Date]

[Hiring Manager's Name]  
[Company Name]  
[Company Address]  
[City, State, Zip]
```

---

#### 2. **Greeting**
Try to address the hiring manager by name.

```plaintext
Dear [Hiring Manager's Name],
```

*Example:*
```plaintext
Dear Ms. Taylor,
```

---

#### 3. **Opening Paragraph: Hook + Purpose**
State why you’re writing, the job you’re applying for, and grab attention.

```plaintext
I am writing to express my interest in the Software Developer Intern position at ABC Tech, as advertised on your careers page. As a final-year Computer Science student with hands-on experience in web development and machine learning, I’m excited by the opportunity to contribute to your innovative projects.
```

---

#### 4. **Middle Paragraph(s): Why You + Why Them**
Highlight your relevant experience, skills, and how they match the job. Also, show knowledge of the company.

```plaintext
In my recent internship at XYZ Corp, I developed a full-stack web application that reduced data processing time by 30%. I also collaborated on a team project using React and Node.js, which sharpened my communication and problem-solving skills. I’m particularly drawn to ABC Tech’s commitment to open-source development and AI ethics, which align with my own interests in responsible computing.
```

*Tip:* Use **quantified achievements** and tailor to the job description.

---

#### 5. **Closing Paragraph: Call to Action**
Summarize, express enthusiasm, and request an interview.

```plaintext
I would welcome the opportunity to further discuss how my background and passion for technology can benefit ABC Tech. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of an interview.
```

---

#### 6. **Sign-Off**
Use a professional close.

```plaintext
Sincerely,  
[Your Name]
```

---

### FULL SAMPLE COVER LETTER

```plaintext
John Doe  
123 Main Street  
San Jose, CA 95112  
johndoe@email.com | (123) 456-7890 | linkedin.com/in/johndoe  

May 22, 2025

Ms. Sarah Taylor  
Hiring Manager  
ABC Tech  
456 Silicon Blvd  
Mountain View, CA 94043

Dear Ms. Taylor,

I am writing to express my interest in the Software Developer Intern position at ABC Tech, as advertised on your careers page. As a final-year Computer Science student with hands-on experience in web development and machine learning, I’m excited by the opportunity to contribute to your innovative projects.

During my internship at XYZ Corp, I developed a full-stack web app using React, Node.js, and MongoDB, which reduced internal processing time by 30%. Additionally, I implemented a machine learning model that improved product recommendation accuracy by 15%. My passion for building efficient and scalable systems, coupled with strong teamwork and problem-solving skills, make me a great fit for your agile development environment.

I admire ABC Tech’s commitment to ethical AI and open-source contributions. I’ve followed your GitHub repositories and even contributed a minor bug fix to your TensorFlow project last year. Joining your team would allow me to learn from the best while contributing to projects that matter.

I would welcome the opportunity to further discuss how my background and passion for technology can benefit ABC Tech. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of an interview.

Sincerely,  
John Doe
```

---

Want a custom version for a specific role or company? Just tell me the job title and your background, and I’ll write it.
